_about: The narration voices newsreel ships with, so a fresh machine does not have to recreate them. Preset voices are metadata (Voicebox already has the Kokoro engine); a cloned voice ships as its exported archive. Install them with: newsreel voices

voices.name: Narrator George
voices.about: Warm British male narration. The default for reports and walkthroughs.

voices.name: Narrator Nova
voices.about: Clear female narration. Pairs with George for two-hander scripts.

voices.name: Karo
voices.about: A cloned voice, shipped as an example of the clone workflow.
voices.note: A cloned voice is a real person's voice. Replace this with your own before publishing anything, and do not synthesize someone's voice without their consent.
